how_to_edit: Edit by hand after testing a model on real games. recommended = best general model, tier_picks says which one the app highlights for 8, 12 and 16+ GB of VRAM (each pick must be in recommended). specialist = JP to EN fine-tunes. experimental = exists but not yet tested for translation. vram_gb = download size + about 1.5 GB. tag = exact Ollama tag, letters, digits and . _ : / - only. Verify a tag exists before adding it.
